title: Professional Certificate Course in Leadership Performance and Assessment in Public Health
description: In this course, the learners will learn about the skills required for public health leadership and performance.
longDescription: The Professional Certificate Course in Leadership, Performance and Assessment in Public Health equip participants with the skills and knowledge needed to lead public health initiatives effectively. The course covers topics such as performance management, leadership principles, and assessment strategies specific to public health.
